collections_kind_scope_check.name: collections_kind_scope_check
collections_kind_scope_check.value: ("collections"."kind" = 'folder' AND "collections"."library_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("collections"."kind" IN ('manual', 'person') AND "collections"."library_id" IS NULL)

collections_manual_identity_check.name: collections_manual_identity_check
collections_manual_identity_check.value: "collections"."kind" != 'manual' OR ("collections"."title" IS NOT NULL AND "collections"."uid" IS NOT NULL)

idx_photos_geo_timeline.name: idx_photos_geo_timeline
idx_photos_geo_timeline.where: "photos"."deleted_at" IS NULL AND "photos"."latitude" IS NOT NULL AND "photos"."longitude" IS NOT NULL
